title: Weighted Hölder inequality
statement:
Let $I$ be a finite set with weights $w_i\ge0$, and let $p,q$ be Hölder-conjugate real exponents. For any $f,g:I\to\mathbb R$,
\[
\sum_{i\in I}w_i f_i g_i\le\left(\sum_{i\in I}w_i|f_i|^p\right)^{1/p}\left(\sum_{i\in I}w_i|g_i|^q\right)^{1/q}.
\]
replaced: Let $I$ be a finite set with nonnegative weights $w_i$, and let $p,q>1$ satisfy $1/p+1/q=1$. For $f,g:I\to\mathbb R$, $\sum_iw_if_ig_i\le(\sum_iw_i|f_i|^p)^{1/p}(\sum_iw_i|g_i|^q)^{1/q}$.
